variants.headline: Party divides in two
variants.body: A political party has split in two in {colony}. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: A political organisation breaks apart
variants.body: The colony has seen a party divide into two organisations. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.

variants.headline: Unity gives way to a party split
variants.body: A split has divided a political party in the colony. Commercial judgment requires a disciplined distinction between the established development and assumptions about its practical consequences.
